leadText: Jiro Saito (斉藤 次郎 Saitō Jirō) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Jiro Saito (斉藤 次郎 Saitō Jirō) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Saito was born on May 24 in , and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined during , where his only role was Mohn, father of both and and husband of Lusamine. Saito is currently affiliated with talent agency Kenyuu Office.
